patches_note: none: the working tree was clean at build time (git status --porcelain empty) and no source file was edited. The graph.json -> MQLib conversion lives in our own tools/to_mqlib.py, not in a patch to upstream.

source_digest.method: sha256 over the sorted `sha256sum` output of every src/**/*.cpp and include/**/*.h

artifacts_note: Binaries are NOT vendored into this repository (575 KB). The sha256 above identifies the exact executable that produced targets.json; rebuild with build/build_mqlib.sh. A different compiler may produce a different binary and, in principle, a different R_i; the source pin plus flags are the reproducible identity.
reported_vs_recomputed: MQLib's own objective line is recorded per run in logs/runs/*.json as mqlib_reported_objective, purely as a cross-check. The authoritative value is the integer recomputed from graph.json + partition.json by tools/verify_partition.py.
